## Session Context (Ring MCP)

You have access to Ring doorbells, security cameras, and alarm systems via MCP tools.

**Before starting work:**
1. Check device status: list_devices(device_type="all")
2. Review recent events: get_events(limit=10)

**At end of work:**
- Arm/disarm any changed devices
- Log important events to the activity log
